verifications.claim: Roughly three dozen countries, primarily in the Americas, offer unconditional birthright citizenship (jus soli).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Roughly three dozen countries across the globe have unconditional birthright citizenship... Most of them are in the western hemisphere" (R2); "Over 30 countries, nearly all of them in the Americas" (R3); "About three dozen countries have unrestricted birthright citizenship... nearly every country in Central and South America" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state roughly 30-35 countries, mostly in Americas/Western Hemisphere, offer unconditional jus soli.

verifications.claim: Countries offering unconditional birthright citizenship automatically grant citizenship to almost anyone born within their territory, regardless of the parents' citizenship status.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "automatic citizenship to anyone born within their borders, regardless of their parents’ nationality or immigration status" (R4); "automatically grant citizenship to those born on their soil, regardless of any other conditions" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct definitions in sources match the claim precisely.

verifications.claim: Almost every country in the Western Hemisphere grants birthright citizenship.
